core_themes: Space pirates, corsair syndicates, and frontier survival
Awe, majesty, and terror of the cosmic deep
Tactical vacuum naval battles with zero sound

science_rules.propulsion: Newtonian reaction mass; antimatter-catalyzed fusion torch drives; flip-and-burn deceleration phases; realistic delta-v budgets.
science_rules.relativity: Kerr rotating black holes with ergospheres and frame-dragging; time dilation governed by general relativity (d_tau = d_t * sqrt(1 - 2GM/(r*c^2))); subjective minutes equal centuries outside.
science_rules.combat: No sound in vacuum; thermal radiators glow cherry-red with heat buildup; railguns firing hypervelocity tungsten penetrators at 50-70 km/s; point-defense cannons (PDC); nuclear-pumped laser torpedoes; light-speed sensor lag and thermal bloom.
science_rules.gravity: No magical gravity plating; artificial gravity generated exclusively by centrifugal spin or linear thruster acceleration (thrust gravity).

protagonist.name: Commander Leo Mercer
protagonist.profile: Elite experimental test pilot and aeronautical propulsion engineer. Pragmatic, observant, fiercely competent under high-g pressure. Possesses manual flight reflexes and analog mechanical intuition long lost to the 31st century. Deeply affected by the realization that everyone he ever knew, including Earth's civilization, has been gone for ten centuries.
protagonist.vessel: The Chronos-1 Prototype — an experimental deep-space interceptor with a carbon-graphene composite hull and early-generation antimatter-catalyzed fusion torch.

female_lead.name: Captain Astrid 'Vex' Ross
female_lead.profile: Captain of the scavenger-corsair frigate 'Starlight Marauder'. Hardened by the ruthless survival codes of the asteroid syndicates. Brilliant orbital tactician with an unapologetic moral compass: she preys on corrupt corporate haulers to feed her crew of outcasts. Cynical, sharp-tongued, and fiercely protective, she is utterly captivated and bewildered by the living 1,000-year-old pilot she pulls from the void.
female_lead.vessel: The Starlight Marauder — a modified 280-meter converted mining frigate bristling with concealed spinal railguns, PDCs, and oversized thermal radiation wings.

key_supporting.name: Orlo
key_supporting.profile: Cynical, grease-stained cybernetic mechanic on the Marauder who treats Leo's ancient vessel like a religious artifact.

key_supporting.name: Commodore Valen Hawke
key_supporting.profile: Supreme enforcer of the Archon Dominion, an authoritarian armada that ruthlessly purges independent pirate systems.

books.title: Relic of the Void
books.summary: The catastrophic test flight near the Cygnus X-1 black hole; relativistic slingshot jumping 1,000 years into the future; salvaged by Captain Astrid 'Vex' Ross; defending the pirate frigate against rival corsairs; uncovering that Earth is now an ancient myth.

books.title: Corsair's Nebula
books.summary: Navigating the lawless Asteroid Belt Syndicates; Leo proves his worth in manual dogfighting; simmering romance between pilot and captain; discovery of a pre-collapse military beacon.

books.title: The Star-Eater's Wake
books.summary: Expedition through uncharted nebulae and deadly magnetar storms; breathtaking cosmic wonder; ambush by the Dominion armada; confessions of love under the light of a dying star.

books.title: Sovereigns of the Dark
books.summary: All-out war between the Dominion and the free pirate fringe; massive tactical space battles; Astrid is captured; Leo executes an impossible high-g rescue.

books.title: The Cradle of Stars
books.summary: The journey back to the ancient Sol system; the truth behind the Golden Age collapse; one final relativistic slingshot maneuver to break the Dominion flagship; founding a new free era among the stars.
